text:
Kai Morgan: Hi finance  saw a $18.75 charge labeled 'TOLL PROCESSING FEE' from the rental company on my corp card after returning the car from an airport trip. The actual tolls (EZ-Pass) were $6.50 but the vendor added a processing fee + admin markup of $12.25. Can we reimburse the tolls only or is the whole fee allowed?

expenses-bot: Policy note: tolls charged by vendor are reimbursable. Third-party admin/processing markups > $5 require manager approval and GL review. Please attach the rental agreement/line-item invoice and the toll statement.

Nina Park: @Kai please upload the rental return receipt and the toll invoice. If the vendor shows a 'processing fee' separate from tolls we typically reimburse the toll amount and escalate the markup to AP for vendor dispute. Manager sign-off needed to reimburse markups > $5.

Kai Morgan: Uploaded: rental_return_121024.pdf and ezpass_statement.png. Rental folio shows: Tolls $6.50, Toll processing $12.25.

Diego Alvarez: Manager note: This was client site visit in Portland on 2024-11-12, approved. I approve reimbursing the $6.50 tolls. I do not approve the $12.25 vendor markup.

Nina Park: Thanks @Diego. We'll code reimbursement to TRV-NA-CLIENT with vendor "Rental agency (toll processing disputed)". @AP please open dispute with rental provider for the $12.25 markup; advise if vendor policy allows passing through processing fees.

expenses-bot: Expense adjusted: reimbursable amount $6.50. Expense queued to AP as EXP-14567. Non-reimbursable markup flagged for vendor dispute.

Kai Morgan: Got it, thanks all. Will annotate Ramp expense and mark the markup as non-reimbursable.
